Analysis of variance of an experimental design

Source: R/anova.R
design_anova.Rd

Fits the linear model of a classical agricultural design and tests every term against the right error stratum (for instance, main plots of a split-plot against Error a).

Usage

design_anova(
  data,
  response,
  treatment,
  block = NULL,
  row = NULL,
  col = NULL,
  covariate = NULL,
  design = NULL,
  ss_type = 3,
  random_blocks = TRUE,
  random_nested = TRUE,
  transform = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame in long format: one row per plot.

response

Name of the numeric response column.

treatment

Name(s) of the treatment factor(s). In split-plots, strip-plots and nested designs the order matters: the first factor goes on main plots (or is the outer factor).

block

Name of the block column; two names (replicate, block within replicate) for incomplete block designs.

row, col

Names of the row and column factors of a Latin square.

covariate

Name(s) of numeric covariates (analysis of covariance).

design

Identifier of the design (see designs()). When NULL the design is suggested from the roles given.

ss_type

Type of sums of squares: 3 (default, adjusted for all other terms) or 1 (sequential).

random_blocks

In a generalised RCBD, treat blocks as random and test treatments against the block x treatment interaction.

random_nested

In a nested design, treat the inner factor as random and test the outer factor against it.

transform

Optional transformation of the response before the analysis, by its identifier in transformations() ("log", "sqrt", "asin"...). Means are then also reported back-transformed.

Value

An object of class "ad_anova": a list with the ANOVA table (table), the error strata (strata), the grand mean, the coefficient of variation, R squared, the fitted model and the data used.

Examples

fit <- design_anova(maize_nitrogen, "Yield_t_ha", "Nitrogen_kg_ha",
                    block = "Block", design = "rcbd")
fit
#> 
#> Randomised complete block design (RCBD)
#> Response: Yield_t_ha   (n = 16)
#> Type III sums of squares
#> 
#>                Df  Sum Sq Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
#> Block           3  1.0691 0.35637   21.69 1.864e-04 ***
#> Nitrogen_kg_ha  3 21.5509 7.18362  437.27 4.591e-10 ***
#> Residuals       9  0.1479 0.01643                      
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> 
#> Grand mean = 6.03188   CV = 2.12 %   R-squared = 0.9935

design_anova(split_irrigation, "Yield_t_ha", c("Irrigation", "Variety"),
             block = "Block", design = "split_rcbd")
#> 
#> Split-plot in RCBD (main plots in blocks)
#> Response: Yield_t_ha   (n = 24)
#> Type III sums of squares
#> 
#>                     Df   Sum Sq   Mean Sq  F value    Pr(>F)    
#> Block                2 0.452575 0.2262875   300.05 3.322e-03  **
#> Irrigation           1 7.889067 7.8890667 10460.64 9.558e-05 ***
#> Error a (main plot)  2 0.001508 0.0007542                       
#> Variety              3 4.836800 1.6122667  3269.95 9.749e-18 ***
#> Irrigation:Variety   3 0.098733 0.0329111    66.75 9.343e-08 ***
#> Error (residual)    12 0.005917 0.0004931                       
#> 
#> Tested against a higher error stratum:
#>   Block vs Error a (main plot)
#>   Irrigation vs Error a (main plot)
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> 
#> Grand mean = 7.985   CV = 0.28 %   R-squared = 0.9996
